entries.description: ArcKit, the enterprise architecture governance harness, as a Claude Code plugin marketplace. The core plugin adds slash commands that write governed architecture documents from templates: principles, stakeholders, requirements, risk register, business case, decision records, diagrams, Wardley maps, research, vendor evaluation, compliance assessments and a traceability matrix. Community plugins add regional, sector and method overlays.
representativeQueries: write a requirements document, risk register and business case for a UK government project
create architecture decision records and C4 diagrams from project requirements
check a design against the GDS Service Standard and the Technology Code of Practice
produce a Wardley map and a build or buy position for each component
trace every requirement through design to tests

entries.description: ArcKit as a Gemini CLI extension. It adds the ArcKit commands that write governed architecture documents from templates: requirements, risk register, business case, decision records, diagrams, Wardley maps, research and compliance assessments, with the regional, sector and method overlays included.
representativeQueries: architecture governance commands for Gemini CLI
write architecture requirements and a risk register with Gemini CLI
run a UK government Technology Code of Practice review in Gemini CLI

entries.description: ArcKit as a Codex CLI extension. Each ArcKit command ships as an agent skill that writes one governed architecture document from a template, with agent roles and the MCP server configuration the research commands use.
representativeQueries: architecture governance skills for Codex CLI
write a strategic outline business case with Codex
create a data protection impact assessment from a data model with Codex

metadata.install: pip install git+https://github.com/tractorjuice/arc-kit.git && arckit init my-project --ai codex

entries.description: An agent skill that recommends which ArcKit commands to run, and in what order, for a new or in-flight architecture project, from a short triage of sector, project type, current stage and timeline.
representativeQueries: which architecture documents should a new project produce first
what order should I run ArcKit commands in for a UK government project
plan the architecture governance work for a project that is already in delivery

entries.description: An agent skill for Wardley Mapping: value-chain decomposition, evolution stages, OnlineWardleyMaps syntax, gameplay, doctrine and climatic patterns, build or buy and inertia.
representativeQueries: draw a Wardley map of this value chain
where does this component sit on the evolution axis
should we build or buy this capability
which Wardley gameplay patterns apply to this map

entries.description: An agent skill for writing or fixing a Mermaid diagram: flowchart, sequence, class, state, entity-relationship, Gantt, C4, mindmap and timeline diagrams, node shapes, styling, theming, and why a diagram fails to render.
representativeQueries: why does this Mermaid diagram fail to render
write a Mermaid sequence diagram for this flow
draw a C4 container diagram in Mermaid

entries.description: An agent skill for writing or fixing a PlantUML diagram, C4-PlantUML first: sequence, class, activity, state, entity-relationship, component, deployment and use-case diagrams, skinparams and themes, C4 layout conflicts and rendering errors.
representativeQueries: write a C4-PlantUML container diagram for this system
fix this PlantUML rendering error
draw a PlantUML deployment diagram
